title: Give In to Your Anger
text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy unit. Its controller's next action this phase must be an attack action with that unit, if able. It must attack a unit, if able.
rules:
Units must be ready in order to attack.
Your opponent can’t play a card from hand or activate an ability to attack with that unit, they must take the “Attack With a Unit” action.
Abilities that affect what a unit can attack, including abilities that prevent a unit from being attacked, still apply to the Give In to Your Anger attack.
If the chosen unit can’t attack a unit, it must attack a base. If the chosen unit can’t legally attack, your opponent may take a different action.
